svg.text: VDD (pad 12) <- RED = M100 V, 3.3 V rail
GND (pad 13, beside VDD) <- BLACK = M100 GND
HT-CT62, LoRa-side column read from the module underside — silkscreen names, pN = schematic pad
other column: EN 0 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 GND ANT2.4G (1 = SCL, 2 = SDA on the Nano)
Nano V2-2 BOTTOM VIEW (board flipped) — M100 Mini UART wiring
GPIO18/19 have NO pads on the Nano: solder to the module castellations marked 18 and 19. Do NOT use TXD/RXD (CH340 USB lines, next to 19).
